_comment: TicTacToe locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side).

_slots.{symbol}: The player's mark, either X or O
_slots.{opponent_symbol}: The opponent's mark, either X or O
_slots.{cell}: A board cell number between 0 and 8

player_prompt.intro:
Owe udi mukwetu {player_id} mu Tic Tac Toe.
Kolomo yawe ni kuwina misatu mfululizo (kwa mpimo, wima, au diagonale) pa plateau.
Pa tour yawe, ukwete kuchagua numero ya suka (0-8) mukwete kuweka ishara yawe.
Kwa mfano, '[4]' uweka ishara yawe pa cellule ya kati ya plateau.
Kama mukwetu {player_id}, ukwete kuwa '{symbol}', wakati mukwetu wa kuwana ni '{opponent_symbol}'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Difila dia mukanda eu kadiena dienza mu mushindu muimpe to.
invalid_move.out_of_range: {cell} ki ntshisumbu tshidi tshianyishibue to. Udi ne bua kuikala pankatshi pa 0 ne 8.

game_action.placed: Mwadi {player_id} akelaka symbole na ye ({symbol}) kwenye seli {cell}.

outcome.draw: Tshimfuanyi etshi tshidi tshipatula bipeta bibi!
